purpose: Predeclared frame-dense ascent/descent comparison from a different 2-2 state; test a general two-slice stroke-position timing hypothesis, without changing production.
scoring: Only exact opaque supplied templates. Other positions remain unscored. Source live PNGs and completed PNGs remain separate; no image shift.
candidate: Before seeing any captures, separately evaluate the general timing hypothesis y := y - 2*vy immediately before the existing fresh-stroke position reset, applied to every water stroke. This copies the estimated two-frame input/render skew into the simulation position; it is an intentionally testable hypothesis, not a claimed native rule.
validation: Compare neutral and 8-slice calibration cases first. Freeze the unmodified candidate, then evaluate 1/4-slice branches and the prior 150-slice surface cases. Run the existing water tests. Reject on any individual >2px exact-position result or existing regression; do not tune thresholds. Branches share restored encounter states and are not independent full-campaign gameplay.
